You have attempted this same task before and did not succeed. These are the plans you wrote after those attempts.
Trial #1: New plan: I failed because I entered the Home office and immediately chose to go back to the Craft room, which I had already visited, and then finished the game without checking if other unvisited rooms (like the Gallery or Laundry room) were reachable from the current path. I did not maintain a mental map of visited rooms to avoid loops or dead ends. Next time, I will keep a running list of visited rooms. When in the Home office, instead of going back to Craft, I will check if there are any unvisited neighbors. If none exist, I will backtrack to a previously visited room that leads to unexplored areas (like the Gallery) rather than stopping prematurely. I will only say DONE when I am in a room with no unvisited neighbors and have visited all reachable rooms.

New plan: I failed because I entered the Laundry room a second time (having already visited it from the Solarium) and stopped immediately, missing the Gallery and Home office which were accessible via the Craft room. I did not track which rooms I had already visited to avoid revisiting them or getting stuck in loops. Next time, I will maintain a strict list of visited rooms. When in the Laundry room, instead of stopping, I will check the available directions (south, west, east) to see if any lead to unvisited rooms. If none do, I will backtrack to the Gallery or Home office to explore further. I will only output "DONE" after confirming that every reachable room in the map has been visited.
